page.overview:
Who is Marcus?

Marcus was a minor character who was mentioned in Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “Festival Of Death”.

Marcus was a villager and the brother of Fahrak, who was kidnapped and killed by the Festival of Death. Category:Mortal Kombat: Conquest Characters Category:Non-canon Characters Category:Characters Category:Male Characters
